finite_subgroup_source.title: Finite subgroups of SL(2,F) and automorphy
finite_subgroup_source.selected_passages_read: Printed pages 214-215 classification statement, conjugacy scope and explicit E6/E7/E8 generators; PDF page 2.
finite_subgroup_source.imported: Classification up to conjugacy into cyclic, binary dihedral, 2T,2O,2I; inclusions 2T in 2O and 2I. No automorphy or roots-of-unity theorem is imported.
finite_subgroup_source.independent_controls: Exact quaternion generation and projective element-order distributions verify the chosen representatives. These do not reprove classification exhaustiveness.

deductions: For connected G, all reductive H whose component group has no A4,S4,A5 quotient have the full torus-versus-witness classification without sphericity.
Projectivizing an exceptional SL2 factor kills the central-cover kernel and gives an actual surjection H/H0 onto A4,S4,A5.
All remaining connected pairs admit an actual equivariant quotient onto PSL2/S4 or PSL2/A5; universal MZ and nullcone classification questions reduce separately to these two models.
Exact Molien rational identities give minimum nonconstant matrix-entry and left highest-weight degrees 8 and 12.
Q8 commutators rule out the irreducible line-doublet method on the models. Zariski density of <N(T),Gamma> rules out powers of every nonconstant normalizer-invariant function.
Disconnected extension uses the component group of G0 intersect H, not a quotient-only hypothesis on the entire H component group.
assurance: Internal proof and exact finite rational certificates. No independent specialist review, formalization, new exceptional moment witness or general nonspherical classification.
